hypotheses.name: Graph curvature-assortativity surrogate broad screen
hypotheses.method: Across immune/lung/external_lung and seeds 42/43/44 on source/target-disjoint splits and layers {7,11}, built kNN graph-topology surrogates (Forman-like node curvature, local clustering, assortativity residual) and tested incremental AUROC over Euclidean-distance baseline with degree-bin curvature shuffle, topology-feature shuffle, and label-permutation controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean delta AUROC=-0.00719; positive mean domain-splits 2/6; Fisher-significant domain-splits 1/6 (lung/target only)
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this undirected curvature-surrogate variant; only revisit with materially changed directed/signed topology tied to biological support.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Second curvature-surrogate attempt remained net negative and split-fragile under null controls.

hypotheses.name: Biologically anchored contrastive cross-model alignment
hypotheses.method: Seed42 pilot on immune/lung/external_lung with source/target-disjoint splits and layers {7,11}; fit anchor-restricted Procrustes mappings between Geneformer and scGPT topology signatures using DoRothEA+OmniPath+STRING+GO anchors, then scored held-out target-domain edges and evaluated null-gap against random-map, signature-destroy, and anchor-label-shuffle controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean transfer delta AUROC=+0.04757 but mean null_gap_q95=-0.12923; robust support concentrated in immune only (domain Fisher p=0.00116)
hypotheses.next_action: Run at most one immune-focused rescue with explicit null-gap optimization; otherwise retire cross-model alignment branch for this loop.

hypotheses.name: Layer-transition intrinsic-dimension gradient screen
hypotheses.method: Across immune/lung/external_lung and seeds 42/43/44 on source/target-disjoint splits, computed local ID at layer transitions (0->3, 3->7, 7->11), built transition-gradient edge features, and tested incremental AUROC over geodesic-distance baseline with layer-order swap, endpoint-swap-within-geodesic-bins, and label-permutation controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean delta AUROC=-0.02061; positive mean domain-splits 1/6; all transition aggregates negative (0->3=-0.01843, 3->7=-0.02018, 7->11=-0.02324)
hypotheses.next_action: Retire intrinsic-dimension AUROC-lift branch unless the endpoint is materially changed to perturbation-grounded calibration.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Both endpoint and transition ID formulations are now net negative under multiseed controls.
